name: JSON:API Cross Bundles
description: Adds cross-bundle JSON:API collection endpoints at /jsonapi/{entity_type_id} that return entities from every bundle of an entity type in one paged, sortable, filterable request.

suggests.drupal/jsonapi_extras: Compatible; the decoration is written to coexist with JSON:API Extras (dev-only requirement, ^3).

project_description: Experimental code for adding cross-bundle resource collections for Drupal's JSON:API module. Decorates the JSON:API resource type repository and field resolver to expose one collection endpoint per entity type (for entity types that have bundles) that returns entities across all bundles. Read-only. Requires Drupal core 8.8 or higher.
